newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin unchanged at 14.17 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin unchanged at 14.17 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price closed unchanged at 14.17 ringgit ($5.69) a kg after some buying support prevented the market from falling following Friday's lower close on the London Metal Exchange (LME), traders said.
"The market is steady and seems to be adopting a wait-and-see attitude on the LME," said a trader.
Initial bids matched offers for a final turnover of 54 tonnes, compared to 86 on Friday. Buyers were from Japan and Malaysia. The local premium over London widened to $80 a tonne from $55 previously.
